author: Heatvent
releaseNotes:
v1.0.5 - importUrl in both driver definitions (Hubitat Import button can refresh them); Apache-2.0 LICENSE/NOTICE.
v1.0.4 - Hover tooltips on non-obvious preferences (3-way, exclusion, relay/smart-bulb, associations, profile override, guidelight; dimmer also switch-mode + min dim).
v1.0.3 - ConfigReport syncs prefs; association maxNodes from device; driverVersion Data Value; DV fingerprints; setRelayControl / get|setParameter / identify; factoryResetDevice (param 84) on 700S/800S.
v1.0.2 - Live Config-Get verification: 500S dimmer min/max (30/31), switch relay control (39), drop unsupported 700S/800S ramp (6), clearer preference labels.
v1.0.1 - Persist detected profile to device Data Values; author normalized to Heatvent.
v1.0.0 - Initial multi-model Switch and Dimmer drivers (500S/700S/800S) with profile auto-detect.
